does: Creates the Config. Sent once by the program's upgrade authority.
Changes the Config.
Reallocates a legacy 116-byte Config to 118 bytes and sets `max_open_answer_bytes`.
Zeroes trailing pre-Build-4 padding bytes in a Model account so trailing `price_unit` decodes cleanly as `Call`.
Creates a Model in `Uploading`, binds its initial Weights accounts and funds its upload keys.
Binds additional preallocated Weights accounts to an uploading model, up to 64 total.
Writes ciphertext bytes into one Weights account.
Hashes 1 to 8 consecutive 65,552-byte ciphertext chunks into the model's Merkle frontier.
Finalizes the ciphertext root hash and moves the model to `Sealed`.
Sets a model's price, price mint, operator share and price unit.
Replaces a model's allowed measurements list (1 to 8).
Moves a model to `Retired`. No new calls open.
Creates an Enclave from a current attestation record.
Copies the enclave's current attestation record into its Enclave account and sets its endpoint.
Writes a Grant from the owner to an enclave and moves the model to `Live`.
Writes a Grant from an enclave that holds one to another enclave.
Marks a Grant revoked. No new calls open on it.
Sets or clears an enclave operator's quoted operator share on an active Grant (`<= model.operator_share_bps`), reallocating legacy 223-byte Grants to 226 bytes.
Creates a per-call Call and moves the model's price into its escrow.
Creates a per-token metered Call and moves the caller's escrow ceiling into its escrow.
Checks the enclave's signature, writes the Receipt and pays out the escrow.
Checks the enclave's piece signature, writes a 423-byte metered Receipt, pays out count * price and returns the unspent ceiling to the caller.
Returns the escrow of a call past its deadline to the caller.
Creates an immutable Measurement PDA binding a 48-byte SHA-384 digest to its source repo, commit SHA, recipe hash and version.
Marks a published Measurement PDA as `Deprecated`. Callable only by its publisher or `Config.admin`.
Creates or updates a model's Policy PDA and sets `model.has_policy = true`. Callable only by the model's owner.
Closes a model's Policy PDA, returns its rent to the owner and sets `model.has_policy = false`. Callable only by the model's owner.
Creates a ModelVersion PDA in `Uploading` for `model.effective_version() + 1` and binds its preallocated Weights accounts while the model stays live on its current version.
Writes ciphertext bytes into one Weights account belonging to an uploading ModelVersion.
Hashes 1 to 8 consecutive 65,552-byte ciphertext chunks into an uploading ModelVersion's Merkle frontier.
Finalizes an uploading ModelVersion's Merkle root and atomically flips the Model's active weights, hash, manifest, base, nonce prefix and `current_version`.
